_help: Everything visible on the site comes from this file. Edit, save, refresh - no build step.
Array order is display order. Add or remove sections freely; 'layout' picks the renderer: text | links | projects | posts | now.
Set "hidden": true on any section or item to hide it without deleting it.
Journal entries without a "date" render as a single line (used for the blog index link).
Profile: avatar falls back to initials if the image fails. Leave "avatar" empty to hide it.
If the page shows an error card, serve the folder over HTTP (py -m http.server 8000) - browsers block local file reads.

profile.name: Suchibhas Nanda
profile.tagline: Present day, present time. Full-stack engineer, backend-leaning - compliance-heavy fintech on one screen, compilers and small strange things on the other.

items.text: I'm a full-stack engineer, backend-leaning - most at home in the part of the stack where data models, permissions and business rules actually live. Lately that has meant compliance-heavy fintech: KYC, FATCA/CRS and multi-party onboarding on FastAPI, PostgreSQL and React/Next.js.
Before that: a B.Tech in Computer Science from GIT Bhubaneswar, a compiler for an 8-bit CPU written in C, and an Odia speech pipeline that grew into a translation tool for English and Chinese.
Away from work I break things on purpose - hardware, emulators, this website - and write down whatever survives.

items.name: SimpleLang 8-bit compiler
items.desc: a compiler for an 8-bit CPU: lexer, semantic analyzer and code generation written in C. understands declarations, datatypes and simple operations.

items.name: Regional language translation
items.desc: Odia speech and text to English and Chinese. Wav2Vec2 fine-tune for Odia transcription, IndicTrans2 for translation, Streamlit for the UI.

items.name: Questify
items.desc: quest-based tasks, levels, rewards and ranks. closed beta with 100 users; 45 of them said gamification made them more compelled to finish things.
